description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeDependentService component within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee dependent entities, mocking data access objects and verifying the service layer logic.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of EmployeeDependentService methods such as retrieval, creation, deletion, and search of employee dependents within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeDependentService, sets a fixture path and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests retrieval of dependents for a specific employee, mocking DAO responses and verifying the correctness of returned dependents list.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests fetching a single dependent for an employee, mocking DAO response and asserting the dependent's data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests saving an employee dependent, ensuring the service correctly persists and returns the entity with proper attributes.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple dependents for an employee, verifying the number of affected rows returned.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests search functionality with filter parameters, verifying that the search returns expected dependents.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Tests counting dependents matching search filters, ensuring the correct count is returned.
